change.description: Apply captured issuer successor-transition assertions with an explicit demo boundary, minute-precision cutoff and issuer-policy expiration interpretation; no executable conversion is inferred.

successor.description: Issuer-linked successor identity independently matched to captured initialized mint state; no conversion mechanics or entitlement implied.

sources.description: Issuer transition and deadline wording; also allows any other token. Assertions do not prove an IPO, legal worthlessness or execution.
Demo effective/evaluation boundary and conservative deadline interpretation; not the actual IPO time, legal value or issuer execution mechanism.
